notes.title: The Blueprints Update is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As announced a few weeks ago, we have been hard at work on the Blueprints update, featuring the highly requested blueprint feature, unlockable in the tech tree, along with other additions to smooth out your overall experience!

To celebrate, Microtopia is 30% off for the first time ever, so if you or a friend haven’t picked up a copy yet, now’s the perfect time!

We hope you enjoy this update and are looking forward to your feedback! 🐜 
 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750000/Microtopia/"][/dynamiclink] 
Blueprints Update - Full patch notes:
Added blueprints, unlockable in the tech tree. Duplicate entire groups of buildings by using floor tiles.

Added Steam Workshop functionality with blueprints.

Added the floor tile selector, used to make blueprints.

Added the link counter gate, a new logic trail that counts ants that are 'linked' to it. The link won't be lost whenever an ant is upgraded.

Counter ends can clear links from ants.

Changed the counter gate area calculation algorithm. Nested counter gates should now be more straightforward. You can choose between a few different calculation settings.

Added gate chaining functionality. Gates 'chained' consecutively without any splits will act as AND gates and will all be checked at once whenever an ant passes the first one.

Removed concrete core functionality, concrete floor tiles now cost 1 concrete to build.

Added 12 new iron decorational pieces.

Changed the concrete core to be a decorational piece.

Added 11 new concrete decorational pieces.

Added resin floor tiles, which can be placed in 10 different colors.

Added functionality to 'drag out' floor tiles so you can place a lot of floor tiles in one go.

Catapult can now be assigned to multiple targets.

Added functionality to copy and paste the settings in a building or gate.

Added C and V hotkeys for copy and paste.

Added pipette hotkey to mouse3, to select a building or trail by hovering over a placed one. Building/gate settings will also be applied.

Added a pause/play button to the interface.

Added Z hotkeys to several 'interact with building' features (stockpile, catapult, flight pads, stockpile gate)

Added Q and E hotkeys to rotate current placing building.

Added option to enable/disable mouse rotation for placing buildings, also possible to have it only when not placing on a grid.

UI when an ant is selected now shows what it is carrying.

Recipe durations shown in building UI.

Tech tree shows required ingredients for building or recipe.

Added holograms of ants and materials that are shown when hovering over applicable buildings and gates.

Changed the gyne cocoon mesh to entice people to use it in a more efficient manner. You'll need to replace the building with a new one, sorry for any inconvenience!

Updated the tech tree, added all new features and rearranged a few things.

Added several new tutorials.

Reduced iron plate recipe ingredients to 3 iron.

Added new giant island variants that can appear randomly when finding islands.

Floor tiles are now displayed in different colors during placements.

Stockpile gate defaults to "less than".

Counter gates can now see ants waiting inside buildings.

Added "Not enough gyne points" text in tech tree.

Made concrete floor tile and decorations cheaper.

notes.title: 1.1 update in the works – here’s what’s coming!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're all well!

As Microtopia is part of the Automation Fest with a 25% discount, we just wanted to keep you posted on our plans for the game.

Microtopia hasn’t been left behind — the developers at Cordyceps Collective are hard at work on the 1.1 update, featuring highly requested features: blueprints, copy/paste, floor tile dragging, decoration, and  a new type of logic gate — the Link Gate! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935601/8a741dd2ccfd158ad374b3521eb872c0dc0d4133.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935601/cf59b1907283535272583696184eeaca017e269d.gif"]

This update will be available later in Q3 2025, along with more info about what’s next for the game. 👀
We can’t wait for you to try out what we’ve been working on and hear your feedback. In the meantime, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts or what you’d like to see added — we’re going through all your feedback!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.9c Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're releasing a small update with some tweaks and fixes. 

While we cannot tell you any date yet, we're now working on some major update ; stay tuned, you'll have news as soon as we've got some to share!

Please find today's patch changelog below :

Microtopia - v1.0.9c

 The radio stockpile is now more expensive to make.
 Changed hazmat digger recipe, now requires digger + hazmat ant at a combiner.
 Fixed an error causing ants to sometimes illegally enter a building.
 Catched an error causing a save to not load.
 Radio stockpile can no longer hold liquids.
 Fixed a few issues with ant descriptions.
 Tweaked hazmat digger recycler yields.


Note : We didn't manage to fix the giant ant bug, as we're not sure what causes it exactly. But we think it's kind of funny and not impacting the experience, so how about it becomes a feature instead? :D

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.9b Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

Get yourselves ready for another update! This time though we bring some new exciting features!
Introducing the radio stockpile and the hazmat digger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935601/3b0f51d521febb6f57bba09afceb7db249e2f58a.png

The radio stockpile is a new special kind of storage building. It has the capability to send construction materials to buildings on other islands! Keep it stocked with a specific material and you’ll always be able to build with it, no matter where you are on the map.
This is a pretty big shift in the balance. It removes a major constraint and will likely shake up progression in different ways, but I’m confident these changes will be for the better!

The hazmat digger is a new ant caste that fills an important gap in the colony’s workforce. Now you can safely dig those hazardous deposits found in later biomes without risking your other ants.
Both of these features can be unlocked in the tech tree. Find all other changes in the changelog!
Hope you have fun!

Microtopia - v1.0.9b Update - Full changelog
New features:

Added a new building: the radio stockpile. Which allows to easily build structures on other islands.
Added a new ant caste: the hazmat digger. A radiation resistant ant that can do mining tasks.
You can now flag stockpiles to not be taken from by smart dispensers.
"Place dispenser" hotkey can now also be used to assign dispensers.
Added "+" and "-" buttons to gate slider UI.

Fixes:

Tweaked hazmat ant recycler yield.
Fixed several typos in translations.
Fixed nuptial flight UI not updating correctly.
Fixed smart dispensers not being able to dispense larvae.
Fixed mold poisoning continuing during pause.
Fixed missing meshes on desert and jungle maps.
Fixed not being able to manually send scrap iron to a stockpile.
Fixed electrolysing getting reset in some cases.
Fixed mining ant continuing mining after being launched by an explosion.
Fixed grinder hitbox.
Changed costs for the concrete core and floortile in the tech tree.
Fixed catapults not being able to throw items onto an undefined stockpile.
Fixed billboards incorrectly displaying in some instances.
Fixed a few problems with the gyne cocoon animation.
Some more optimization with animation culling.
Fixed being able to fill in negative numbers in gate configurations.
Fixed island ant count not updating when ants enter by bridge.
Fixed bridges dropping many ants after being destroyed.

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.8a Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're rolling out a small patch with hotfixes following 1.0.8. Sorry for the inconvenience, here's the full patchnote!

Microtopia - v1.0.8a Update

Caught several errors causing all ants to stop moving, one in the assembler and one in the catapult.
Renamed "ion workers" to "battery workers".
Fixed the click UI not working correctly with a very low framerate.
Fixed ants being confused by many action points.
Fixed mismatch in building percentages.
Tweaked facility and smart dispenser collider, can now be placed together more neatly.
Fixed typo in Japanese.
Fixed a few errors with colliders from islands.
Several optimisation fixes.

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
Hey ants!

Today we bring you another large bug fixing update!
Along with a smoother experience, the update also brings a new quality of life feature, that I think many of you will come to appreciate.

In this update, whenever an item has fallen to the ground, you'll be able to simply click on it to send it to any stockpile available on the island!
You can find the rest of the patch notes in the changelog channel.
Hope you have fun!

v1.0.8 Update full changelog

If an item has fallen to the ground, you can now click on it to send it to a suitable stockpile (if any).
Sending items from stockpile to stockpile can now be done even if the target stockpile can't receive everything.
Added a warning message if an ant tries to go into a building while carrying an item or is not the right caste.
Catapults won't display a warning any longer if the target stockpile can't recieve the item.
Tweaked recycler yields of some drones and heavy worker.
Can now disable fog in settings.
Fixed electrolyser not working after relocating.
Fixed stockpile gate 
Fixed unlocked recipes not being properly reset when starting a new save.
Fixed a ghost trail cause.
Fixed typo in Japanese.
Fixed catapult getting stuck while having ammo.
Fixed catapult being able to overflow a stockpile.
Fixed some installation issues with the GOG version.
Fixed a wrong string when demolishing a building.
Fixed warning signs blocking interaction.
Fixed gyne cocoon being able to have multiple princesses.
Fixed princess not getting old.
Fixed a single ant triggering multiple timer gates.
Fixed collider LOD mesh.
Fixed ants floating in the sky indefinitely after moving a building.
Fixed biome fog not updating when following an ant.
Fixed a few instances where the tooltip didn't properly dissapeared.
Fixed Gynes and princess death poses.
Fixed concrete core not having to be completed to place down concrete floortiles.
Fixed loose LEDs not being interactable.

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.7a Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have fixed some more things since the last update, thank you for your feedback!

 Microtopia - v1.0.7a Update  


Fixed flight animation of later gynes.
Easier building requirements for the recycler.
Fixed a tiling problem in a toxic wasteland ground
Imrpoved dissolver and larva booster functionality to prevent them from getting stuck
All dissolver recipes cost only 1 acid now.
Fixed an error with plants to breaked being able to save.
Fixed acid press wind down animation.
"Ghost trails" (command trails that lost their owner) are now cleaned up on load and will be less spooky.
Fixed a few recycler yields, giving the proper liquid.
Fixed unmineable ancient deposits (they will be removed)
Fixed a nullref with launched ants, causing them to be stuck mid air.
The stockpile gate is unlocked way earlier in the tech tree and no longer costs yellow diamonds.
Placing building on an ant ending its command trail doesn't freeze the game anymore
Fixed build progress billboard showing inside a few buildings.
Added a message when a building requires a dispenser.
Fixed dissolver being able to receive acid directly.
Fixed possibility of the facility getting stuck with some recipes.
Recycler should now pile-up its yield a bit more efficiently.
Fixed sentinels not being able to mine.
Added a few missing mining animations.
Fixed inventor T3 incorrect minimap mesh layer.
 Fixed crystal duping with wafer in the deconstructor.
Fix for a save breaking bug when you've completed all tasks.
Increased the amount of blubber found in toxic mold.
Decreased blubber required for acid, increased amount of acid gained.
Made the idea requiring acid collection easier.
Fixed ants skipping action points when high speed/low framerate
Increased fluid container capacity, changed how to sphere size is calculated.
Fixed jet drone not being able to do anything.
Changed main trail description in English, no longer costs the notorious yellow diamond.
Tweaked recycler yields for a few ants (watch out some might drop acid).
Smaller changes and optimizations.

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.6a Update
notes.content:
Hello!
A short message from us, the developers of Microtopia! We are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming activity on the game, either here or on the game's Discord since Microtopia’s release one week ago. It’s fantastic to see all the ideas and suggestions coming in. We’re also very happy with the friendly and helpful tone of communication among everyone!
We want to assure you that we’re keeping a close eye on all bug reports. Some of the urgent ones have already been fixed and are addressed in this quick-fix patch. (find the changelog below)
There are also some other fixes and changes being currently tested, but those one felt urgent enough to push them today!

Thank you, everyone, and please continue having fun playing Microtopia!


Microtopia - v1.0.6a Update


 Fixed two instances of possible savegame corruption
 Added settings: VSync, FPS Limit, World Volume, Invert Cam
 Render scale setting isn't ignored anymore on game start
 Can now scroll to top part of the tech tree when using small/tiny UI Scale
 Floor Tile Eraser now also removes incomplete floortiles
 Fixed broken wafer recipe

notes.title: Microtopia - v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thanks for the warm welcome you've given Microtopia! We're really happy to see that you're enjoying the game! Your kind words are really great to read.

We also want to thank you for all your feedback, either here on the forums or on the game's Discord. It helps a lot, and it allows us to make the game better and fix some bugs that might've gone through our testing nets!

Some of them are being fixed in this update, please find the full changelog below!

Have a wonderful day, and thanks again for playing Microtopia.

Microtopia - v1.0.5 Update


Fixed a few wrong translations
Added missing credits
Fixed a bug with the counter gate not working and causing not being able to save after having started a new colony without first quitting the game.
Fixed a bug with empty pod workers being able to block the gyne cocoon, halting its progress.
Fixed the tech tree showing a black screen on small resolutions.
Rearranged some things in the tech tree, timer gate and caste gate are easier to unlock.
Made "Flying larvae" objective easier.
Fixed workshop collider
Fixed "new" UI element displayed on gate while it should be gone.

notes.title: Microtopia Needs You: First Playtest Wave is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Big news! The first wave of Microtopia’s playtest is now live and will run until December 9! 🐜
This playtest includes a new build featuring all the content up to Tier 1, representing about 50% of the game’s total progression.

Spots are limited, so make sure to act fast! If you’re part of the first wave, you’ll also get access to the second wave starting December 9, where you can continue exploring new content!

Want to join the fun? It’s easy—just follow these two simple steps:
Step 1 – Request Access
Head to the game page on Steam and hit the “Request Access” button. Once approved, you’ll receive an email granting you access to the playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935601/4b9f25f2b341069596a47a4f4c69a6dd38e5d81d.png

Step 2 – Join Our Discord server
Hop into our Discord server to share your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions with us!
Your input during this playtest is crucial in helping us refine the game and ensure it’s the best it can be. 

Thank you for your support! We can’t wait to see what you think of Microtopia!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750000/Microtopia/

notes.title: Free Prologue Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're happy to announce that the free Prologue of Microtopia is now available for you all to play!

[previewyoutube=RwEBFUD9lus;full][/previewyoutube]

In this automation game, you'll manage a colony of robot ants, design a network of transport trails, explore unique environments and expand your settlement.
Your goal? To reproduce! Create young queens that will fly out during the nuptial flight to spread out to distant lands. Starting the cycle anew.

PROLOGUE CONTENT

 5 types of trails, including 2 logic trails
 11 different buildings to build
 5 kinds of ant castes to produce and interact with
 2 islands to explore featuring 2 different biomes

Play now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3082030/Microtopia_Prologue/
